summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting director/PDMR share purchases. CEO Oliver Friesen acquired 20,000 ordinary shares; Michael Schlumpberger and Jason Starzecki acquired 500 and 1,100 ADSs respectively (each ADS equals 5 ordinary shares). Total consideration is stated per-transaction, no aggregate premium. The filing is a routine disclosure of insider purchases, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named for a deal. This is a standard regulatory update with no structural changes, and there is no event-driven angle to monitor.
